details.description: Mistral Small 24B Instruct 2501, also announced by Mistral AI as "Mistral Small 3", is a 24-billion-parameter instruction-tuned language model released on January 30, 2025. It uses a latency-optimized architecture with fewer layers than comparably sized models, a 32,000-token context window, and the Tekken tokenizer with a 131k vocabulary, and it supports native function calling and JSON output. Mistral AI positions it as an open alternative to proprietary models such as GPT-4o-mini for local, low-latency deployment. On Mistral AI's own hosted API, this model (mistral-small-2501) is listed as deprecated as of 2025-11-06 and retired as of 2025-11-30, superseded by later Mistral Small versions.
advantages: Scores 84.8% (pass@1) on HumanEval and 70.6% on its instruct Math benchmark, per Mistral AI's model card.
Scores 82.9% on IFEval and 66.3% on MMLU Pro (5-shot CoT), per Mistral AI's model card.
Mistral AI reports over 81% accuracy on MMLU and roughly 150 tokens/s generation latency in its launch announcement.
Supports native function calling and JSON output, per Mistral AI's model card.
Fits on a single RTX 4090 GPU or a 32GB-RAM system when quantized, per Mistral AI's launch announcement, enabling local deployment.
Apache 2.0 licensed for commercial and non-commercial use.
disadvantages: Mistral AI's model-status page lists this model (mistral-small-2501, "Mistral Small 3.0") as deprecated as of 2025-11-06 and retired from its own hosted API as of 2025-11-30.
The model card does not describe vision or image input support; it is a text-only model.
use_cases: Local, low-latency conversational assistants and chatbots.
Fast inference on consumer-grade GPUs, such as a single RTX 4090.

notes: Mistral AI's own announcement calls this release "Mistral Small 3"; matched to the catalog's mistral-small-24b-instruct-2501 id via its API name mistral-small-2501 and 24B/Jan-2025 specs. Mistral AI's model-status page lists it deprecated 2025-11-06 and retired 2025-11-30 on its own hosted API; the catalog's facts carry no deprecation_date. Catalog's context window (32768) matches the model card's ~32k figure. Named languages come from an "including" list on the model card ("dozens of languages, including...") that is likely not exhaustive.
